name: silent-whisker
description: Crowdsourced map of stray-cat feeding spots. Hebrew first, English second.

scripts.fallow: fallow dead-code --fail-on-issues --quiet && fallow dupes --fail-on-issues --quiet && fallow health --complexity --fail-on-issues --quiet && fallow audit --quiet
scripts.verify: npm run verify:code && npm run verify:iac
scripts.verify:code: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run fallow
scripts.verify:iac: npm run lint:iac && npm run test:iac
scripts.build: npm run build -w silent-whisker-frontend && npm run build:backend
